issues.issue: Did the RAD breach procedural fairness by raising new credibility issues without notice?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant alleges RAD raised new credibility issues including baptismal certificate and contradictions without notice.
issues.respondent_position: Respondent says RAD did not raise new issues but analyzed credibility on grounds RPD denied claim; baptismal certificate addressed by RPD.
issues.result_text: RAD breached procedural fairness by raising new credibility issues without notice, including baptismal certificate issue.

issues.applicant_position: Applicant argues RAD's findings were unreasonable, including contradictions and treatment of conversion motivation.
issues.result_text: Court need not address unreasonableness due to procedural unfairness.
